cohort: 100 mothers undergoing Cesarean section in a rural hospital in South India.
finding: Intravenous tranexamic acid significantly reduced the average hemoglobin drop (0.4 vs 0.9) and the percentage of subjects with blood loss >250 ml (9% vs 52%) during cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Administration of tranexamic acid during cesarean sections was found to significantly reduce blood loss and hemoglobin drop.
